msg_details_page_title.description: Browser tab / window title of the Details page. $1 is the extension's brand name and must stay byte-identical in every locale (AD-7).

msg_nav_tab_overview.description: Label of the first navigation tab, which shows the listening statistics summary. Short - one word preferred.

msg_nav_tab_settings.description: Label of the second navigation tab, which holds configuration, sync and data management. Short - one word preferred.

msg_nav_tab_about.description: Label of the third navigation tab, which holds the extension description and contact links. Short - one word preferred.

msg_details_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the first tab. Refers to the statistics summary of what the user has played.

msg_details_panel_subtitle.message: Your personal listening statistics and history on YouTube Music.
msg_details_panel_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the Overview title. "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated.

msg_details_stat_total_songs_played.description: Label of the large hero statistic on the Overview tab. A play = one started song on YouTube Music, NOT a unique track and NOT a stream of audio; keep it distinct from the 'Different Songs' label next to it.

msg_details_unit_total_plays.description: Unit shown immediately after the large total-plays number. It is a standalone unit label, not a counted phrase, so it must stay grammatical on its own and must NOT be given a plural form.

msg_details_stat_total_songs_desc.message: Total number of songs played while using the extension.
msg_details_stat_total_songs_desc.description: Explanation under the hero statistic. Clarifies that only listens recorded by this extension are counted.

msg_details_stat_different_songs.description: Label of the small statistic card for the count of DISTINCT songs played, as opposed to the total number of plays. "Different" must not be read as a translation of the artist or album sense.

msg_details_stat_time_listened.description: Label of the small statistic card showing accumulated listening duration.

msg_details_stat_time_zero_min.description: Initial placeholder shown in the Time Listened card before the real duration is computed. JS replaces this immediately; keep it short and keep the abbreviation.

msg_details_stat_artists.description: Label of the statistic card counting distinct artists the user has played.

msg_details_stat_albums.description: Label of the statistic card counting the albums the user has played tracks from. Music-industry sense of 'album', not a generic 'book'.

msg_details_stat_singles.description: Label of the statistic card counting standalone track releases the user has played, as opposed to tracks that belong to an album.

msg_details_stat_albums_finished.description: Label of the statistic card counting albums where the user has heard every track. Past participle - keep it as a completed action, not a future one.

msg_details_albums_section_title.description: Heading of the per-album breakdown section on the Overview tab.

msg_details_albums_subtext_default.message: See which songs you've heard from each album and track your progress.
msg_details_albums_subtext_default.description: Sub-heading of the per-album breakdown section, shown when 3 or fewer albums are tracked and there is no top-3/show-all toggle to describe. details.js reuses this exact string in that state - keep the two call sites identical.

msg_details_albums_show_all_albums.description: Initial label of the button that expands the album list from the top 3 to every tracked album. details.js overwrites this label with a counted variant once more than 3 albums exist, so this uncounted form is the pre-data / under-threshold state.

msg_details_albums_refresh.description: Button that re-reads the album breakdown from storage.

msg_details_albums_empty_state.message: No albums tracked yet. Sync your listening history or play an album to get started.
msg_details_albums_empty_state.description: Empty state shown in the album breakdown list when the user has no tracked albums. Two sentences: state the problem, then suggest the two ways out (syncing history, or simply playing an album). details.js renders this same string in a generated card - keep the two identical.

msg_settings_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the Settings tab. The section covers both preferences and stored data.

msg_settings_panel_subtitle.message: Manage your extension settings, sync history, and data preferences.

msg_settings_section_language.description: Heading of the language selector section in Settings.

msg_settings_language_label.description: Label for the language dropdown. Also used as the dropdown's accessible name for screen readers, so keep it short enough to work as an aria-label.

msg_settings_language_desc.message: Choose the language used for this extension's own interface text.
msg_settings_language_desc.description: Helper text under the language dropdown label. Clarifies that the setting covers the in-page UI only, which is what users often misunderstand.

msg_settings_language_manifest_note.message: The extension name and description shown in your browser's extension manager always follow the browser's own language setting and cannot be changed here.
msg_settings_language_manifest_note.description: Disclaimer explaining a platform limitation: the browser resolves the manifest name and description from the BROWSER locale at install/update time, so no in-page setting can override them. Must not promise the user any way to change them - that would be false on both Chrome and Firefox.

msg_settings_language_follow_browser.description: Label of the language dropdown's first option, which is the empty value meaning 'use whatever language the browser is set to'. Not a language name - it is an instruction.

msg_settings_section_history_sync.description: Heading of the section that imports past listening history from YouTube Music.

msg_settings_sync_previous_title.description: Title of the history import card inside the sync section.

msg_settings_sync_previous_desc.message: Import past plays directly from YouTube Music to include your previous listening history in your stats.
msg_settings_sync_previous_desc.description: Explanation of what the history import does. "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated.

msg_settings_sync_status_checking.description: Transient status text in the sync pill while the extension reads the stored sync watermark. Shown for a moment on page load, then replaced. Keep the ellipsis convention of the target locale.

msg_settings_start_history_sync.description: Button that launches the background history scanner. Verb-first button label.

msg_settings_scanner_badge_syncing.description: Status badge in the live scanner panel, shown before any track has been imported. details.js replaces this badge text with 'Fetching Metadata' / 'Metadata Ready' while the enrichment pass runs, so this is specifically the initial scanning state.

msg_settings_scanner_plays_found.description: Count readout beside the scanner status badge, showing zero before the scan begins. This is a STATIC HTML-only string, NOT a plural base: the live count is rendered separately by details.js through plural('msg_scanner_plays_synced', count), so no _zero/_one/_other forms of this key exist or are needed. Translate it as the zero-state wording and keep it consistent in tone with the live count that replaces it.

msg_settings_scanner_now_syncing.description: Label introducing the name of the track currently being imported. Ends with a colon because a track name follows it.

msg_settings_scanner_connecting.description: Placeholder track name shown in the scanner panel before the first track arrives.

msg_settings_debug_options_title.description: Title of the toggle that reveals the developer diagnostics section.

msg_settings_debug_options_desc.message: Show developer diagnostics, connection checks, and live debug logs.
msg_settings_debug_options_desc.description: Explanation of what the Debug Options toggle reveals.

msg_settings_toggle_debug_options.description: Tooltip on the Debug Options switch. Rendered as a mouse tooltip, so keep it short and verb-first.

msg_settings_debug_section_title.description: Heading of the hidden diagnostics section revealed by the Debug Options toggle.

msg_settings_debug_ping.description: Debug button that pings the content script to verify it is alive and responding.

msg_settings_debug_check_storage.description: Debug button that reads and reports the state of extension storage.

msg_settings_debug_reset_boundary.description: Debug button that clears the history sync watermark so the next sync re-scans from scratch. 'Boundary' is the project's term for that watermark - keep it as one word if the target language has a natural compound, otherwise pick the clearest ordinary word for the scan position.

msg_settings_debug_clear_logs.description: Debug button that empties the on-page diagnostics console.

msg_settings_debug_tag_yt_tab.description: Transient debug status tag reporting whether the content script is present on a YouTube Music tab. "YT" is an abbreviation of the product name and should stay abbreviated.

msg_settings_debug_tag_storage.description: Transient debug status tag reporting the result of the storage check.

msg_settings_debug_tag_boundary.description: Transient debug status tag reporting the history sync watermark. Same 'Boundary' terminology as the Reset Boundary button.

msg_settings_debug_tag_scanner_idle.description: Initial debug status tag showing the history scanner is not running. Paired with 'Boundary'/'Storage' tags that use the same 'Label: State' punctuation, so keep the colon.

msg_settings_debug_tag_tracklists_idle.description: Initial debug status tag showing the metadata / tracklist fetch pass is not running. 'Tracklists' is the platform name for a song's track listing - do not translate it as a literal musical track list.

msg_settings_debug_min_tracks.description: Label of the numeric debug input controlling how many tracks are bundled into one metadata request. Abbreviate 'Minimum' to fit the tight debug bar.

msg_settings_debug_fetch_missing.description: Debug button that requests metadata for tracks whose tracklists are not yet cached.

msg_settings_debug_console_placeholder.message: Diagnostics initialized. Activity and error logs will appear here in real time.
msg_settings_debug_console_placeholder.description: Initial text of the on-page debug console before any log line arrives. Developer-facing, but it is fixed UI chrome rather than log output, so it is translated like any other label.

msg_settings_section_cover_art.description: Heading of the section covering the cached album artwork.

msg_settings_thumbnail_db_title.description: Title of the card describing the on-device album art cache.

msg_settings_thumbnail_db_desc.message: Album covers are downscaled to 128×128 WebP and stored in IndexedDB for instant, zero-flicker offline rendering.
msg_settings_thumbnail_db_desc.description: Explanation of the thumbnail cache. "WebP" and "IndexedDB" are proper technical names and are not translated; keep the numbers 128 and 128 exactly as written.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_calculating.description: Placeholder shown in the thumbnail cache badge while the size is being computed.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_check_size.description: Button that recomputes the thumbnail cache entry count and total size.

msg_settings_thumbnail_cache_clear.description: Button that deletes all cached album artwork. "Cover" here means album art, not a book jacket.

msg_settings_section_backup.description: Heading of the section covering library export and import.

msg_settings_backup_title.description: Title of the export/import card. '1-Click' promises that a single action is all it takes - keep that promise in the translation.

msg_settings_backup_desc.message: Export your complete play counts, listening durations, and album completions as a standardized, versioned JSON bundle, or import an existing backup.
msg_settings_backup_desc.description: Explanation of what the export contains and that an existing backup can be re-imported. "JSON" is a format name and is not translated.

msg_settings_export_library.description: Button that downloads the full library as a JSON file. The (.json) suffix is a literal file extension - keep it exactly as written.

msg_settings_import_library.description: Button that opens a file picker to restore a JSON backup. The (.json) suffix is a literal file extension - keep it exactly as written.

msg_settings_section_reset_data.description: Heading of the danger zone where all stored data can be erased.

msg_settings_reset_all_title.description: Title of the danger-zone card. Same wording as the button below it - keep the two consistent in every locale.

msg_settings_reset_all_desc.message: Permanently clear all your saved play counts, artists, and album listening history. This cannot be undone.
msg_settings_reset_all_desc.description: Warning describing exactly what Reset All Data destroys. The final sentence must stay a clear, unambiguous statement that the action is irreversible.

msg_settings_reset_all_button.description: Label of the button that enters the 3-step reset confirmation flow. Same wording as the card title immediately above it - keep the two consistent in every locale.

msg_settings_confirmation_of.description: Badge on the first two steps of the reset confirmation flow. $1 is the step number, $2 is the total step count; both are single digits in the English catalog and are supplied as literal attribute text.

msg_settings_confirmation_final.description: Badge on the last step of the reset confirmation flow. Separate key from the earlier steps so the '(Final)' emphasis can be rendered idiomatically. $1 is the step number, $2 the total.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_title.message: Are you sure you want to reset all data?
msg_settings_confirm_step1_title.description: Question heading of the first reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_note.message: This will erase all recorded play counts and statistics from the extension.
msg_settings_confirm_step1_note.description: Body text of the first reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_cancel.description: Button that abandons the reset confirmation flow at any step. One key shared by all three cancel buttons.

msg_settings_confirm_step1_button.description: Button that advances from the first to the second reset confirmation step. $1 is the current step, $2 the total. The parentheses are part of the English convention - translate the intent, not the punctuation.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_title.message: Please double-check: this cannot be undone!
msg_settings_confirm_step2_title.description: Question heading of the second reset confirmation step, escalating the warning.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_note.message: All your stats, including top songs, artists, and album progress, will be permanently removed.
msg_settings_confirm_step2_note.description: Body text of the second reset confirmation step, naming the specific data that will be lost.

msg_settings_confirm_step2_button.description: Button that advances from the second to the final reset confirmation step. $1 is the current step, $2 the total.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_title.message: Final confirmation: reset all data now?
msg_settings_confirm_step3_title.description: Question heading of the final, irreversible reset confirmation step.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_note.message: Clicking the button below will immediately clear all your stored data.
msg_settings_confirm_step3_note.description: Body text of the final reset confirmation step, stating that the action takes effect immediately.

msg_settings_confirm_step3_button.description: The irreversible button that actually performs the data wipe. Must read as destructive and final. $1 is the current step, $2 the total.

msg_settings_reset_success.message: All data has been reset to zero.
msg_settings_reset_success.description: Confirmation shown in the green success alert once the data wipe completes.

msg_about_panel_title.description: Heading at the top of the About tab. Short - one word preferred.

msg_about_panel_subtitle.message: Everything about this extension and how to reach me.
msg_about_panel_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the About title. Written in the first person by the extension's author; keep the first-person voice.

msg_about_app_name.description: The extension's brand name as shown in the nav bar and the About card. AD-7: this is a brand and MUST be byte-identical in every locale - reproduce it exactly, do not translate, transliterate, localize or add diacritics.

msg_about_version_label.description: Word preceding the version number in the About card. The version number itself is injected by JS and is never translated.

msg_about_blurb.message: $1 keeps a running tally of everything you play on YouTube Music. It counts every track you listen to, tracks per-song and per-artist play counts, recognizes completed albums, and measures your listening time. Everything stays in your browser.
msg_about_blurb.description: The About panel's main marketing paragraph. $1 is the extension's brand name and must stay byte-identical (AD-7); "YouTube Music" is a product name and is not translated. Preserve the selling points in order: counting every play, accurate per-song and per-artist counts, album completion detection, and measured listening time. The last sentence is the local-only guarantee - keep it a plain factual statement, do not expand it into a policy claim.

msg_about_section_contact.description: Heading of the About panel section listing the contact and support links.

msg_about_link_email.description: Label of the link that opens the author's email address. First person, matching the author's voice.

msg_about_link_report.message: Report an issue or request a feature
msg_about_link_report.description: Label of the link to the issue tracker. Covers both bug reports and feature requests, so translate it as one label for both purposes rather than splitting it.

msg_about_link_source.description: Label of the link to the public source repository.

msg_about_whats_new.description: Text preceding the version number in the changelog heading. Ends mid-phrase - the version number follows it - so do not add a full stop and keep it open-ended.

msg_about_made_with.description: Page footer credit. $1 is the author's handle and must be reproduced exactly, never translated or transliterated. The '<3' is a heart emoticon - keep it, or substitute the target locale's equivalent heart symbol.
